scripts.fresh-dev: rm -rf working-area && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:backend: rm -rf dist/backend && mkdir -p dist/backend && cp src/backend/server.js src/backend/app.js src/backend/config.js dist/backend/ && cp -r src/backend/routes dist/backend/ && cp -r src/backend/services dist/backend/ && cp -r src/backend/mcp dist/backend/ && cp -r src/backend/data dist/backend/ && cp -r src/backend/harness dist/backend/ && cp -r agent-templates dist/agent-templates && cp src/backend.js dist/ && cp src/harnessRegistry.js dist/
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
